It lower-cases the text, turns each run of characters outside [a-z0-9] into one hyphen, and strips leading and trailing hyphens. The acceptance command `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q` runs 3 tests and exits 0. slug.py was already in the working tree from the previous attempt and I left it unchanged.
